MIYABISTS2-COMBAT_HARD_SELECTED.title: Challenge Difficulty
MIYABISTS2-COMBAT_HARD_SELECTED.hover.de:
Increasing difficulty also grants [gold]additional bonuses[/gold]. This is penance, and also training.
[gold]1. Antimony Tier[/gold]: Enemies have +10% HP
[gold]2. Zinc Tier[/gold]: At the start of each act, randomly [red]Downgrade[/red] one card
[gold]3. Tin Tier[/gold]: The first card played each combat [red]costs +1[/red]
[gold]4. Manganese Tier[/gold]: At combat start, enemies gain 1 Strength, you lose 1 Strength
[gold]5. Cadmium Tier[/gold]: Enemies instead have +20% HP
[gold]6. Nickel Tier[/gold]: [red]Draw 1 fewer card[/red] for the first three turns
[gold]7. Copper Tier[/gold]: Enemies deal 6 damage on death
[gold]8. Bismuth Tier[/gold]: Enemies instead have +30% HP, and gain an additional 1 Strength
[gold]9. Lead Tier[/gold]: Upon entering a new act, add a random [red]Curse[/red] to your deck
[gold]10. Mercury Tier[/gold]: The first time an enemy would take fatal damage, it gains 1 [gold]Buffer[/gold] and 2 [gold]Strength[/gold] and recovers 30% HP
MIYABISTS2-MIYABI_FUN_PILE_SELECTED.hove:
Choose a different special challenge.
[gold]Default[/gold]: No changes
[gold]Bangboo House[/gold]: Starting deck becomes a Bangboo-related deck
[gold]Swarm Assembly[/gold]: Add 1 upgraded [gold]Swarm Assembly[/gold] to your starting deck
[gold]Skeletal Recorder[/gold]: Start with a [gold]Fairy Tale Notebook[/gold]
[gold]Grace's Counterattack[/gold]: Starting deck becomes a Grace deck
